non_descending_object: A quantum amplitude over geometries / an entanglement-structured pre-geometric state-of-the-metric. STATEMENT: the object in NEITHER endpoint's Sigma_f that would close the gap is a JOINT object carrying, simultaneously: (a) a genuine quantum STATE (superposition/amplitude/coherence) whose ARGUMENT is the GR metric / causal structure itself -- i.e. a superposition of geometries -- and (b) an entanglement/quantum-information ledger from which a metric / area is RECONSTRUCTED rather than assumed. Equivalently: the predicate 'amplitude(geometry)' and the predicate 'area = shadow-price(entanglement)'. WHY IN NEITHER Sigma_f: (quantum_mechanics) QM's frozen Sigma_f keeps <A>, spectra, Born weights, the diagonal classical distribution, and entanglement CORRELATIONS -- but its carrier Z is a density operator on a FIXED finite Hilbert space with NO spacetime/metric argument. A 'state whose argument is a geometry' is not expressible: QM has the quantum machinery but no metric to put under it. Entanglement entropy is an accepted observable, but 'entanglement entropy AS the source of an area / a length' is not in Sigma_f (it is the named-import content of E024). (general_relativity) GR's frozen Sigma_f EXPLICITLY excludes it: 'NOT in Sigma_f: any quantum-gravitational predicate (graviton scattering, Planck-scale structure), a quantum state of the metric -- these are non-definable from the classical geometric lens (this field certifies the QM<->GR gap as a missing predicate, not a hidden one).' GR has the metric but no amplitude/coherence over it; it is the CLASSICAL casting by deliberate, conservative choice. (joint) The object is non-descending from BOTH because each endpoint holds exactly ONE of its two halves and the LENS of each forbids the other half: QM's lens has no geometry argument; GR's lens has no quantum amplitude. The gap is precisely the absence of a single Sigma_f in which 'amplitude' and 'geometry' are BOTH definable and COUPLED. ATLAS-INTERNAL EVIDENCE THAT IT IS MISSING NOT HIDDEN: GR's Sigma_f field self-certifies the exclusion as a MISSING predicate, not a hidden one. E034 (GR->QFT-curved) is the closest the atlas gets and it stops at a FIXED background with NO back-reaction quantized -- its own note: 'It does NOT close quantum gravity (E018).'

divergence.explanation: PARTIAL match, with one structurally important DIVERGENCE that the firewall downgrades to casting-dependent. (1) MATCHES (FIRM): SBT agrees a layer is missing (E3, not a dead end); agrees L must carry a quantum amplitude over geometry (the 'state of the metric' predicate, exactly 'quantize the metric'); agrees classical GR is a shadow of L (hbar->0 / large-area limit); agrees the non-renormalizability route-mismatch (P3) is the located obstruction. So the 'quantize the metric' candidate is a LEGITIMATE casting of the primary required predicate. (2) DIVERGES (CASTING-DEPENDENT, flagged): the atlas's OWN corroborating edges (E024, E023, E005) point to an ASYMMETRY the naive 'quantize the metric' picture lacks -- they say GEOMETRY IS A SHADOW OF ENTANGLEMENT (area = shadow-price of entanglement entropy), i.e. the metric is RECONSTRUCTED from a deeper quantum-information substrate rather than being a fundamental field that one quantizes directly. Under this atlas-internal reading, 'quantize the metric' is quantizing a SHADOW (a derived, coarse object) -- which structurally PREDICTS the failure of naive metric-quantization (non-renormalizability) as 'you are quantizing the wrong, emergent variable.' BUT THIS IS A CASTING ARTIFACT, NOT A PHYSICS DISCOVERY (audit-hardened): (i) E023 is a BIDIRECTIONAL duality-equivalence ('neither as source'; F41 = 'a bidirectional shadow, not a reduction of either side') and CANNOT be cited as directional 'geometry-is-downstream' evidence -- that over-read is excised; only E024's currency-shadow-price orientation carries any asymmetry and it is a single E2-conditional edge, too thin to headline an asymmetric hole; (ii) GR was DELIBERATELY cast classical (its card REJECTS the semiclassical Alternative-2 to avoid flattering the gap), so the 'geometry is a shadow' signal is substantially an artifact of that conservative casting -- under a geometry-from-entanglement-primary casting the divergence would relocate or vanish. SBT does NOT adjudicate; it FLAGS that its own (E2-conditional) edges PREFER emergent-geometry, while conceding the preference is casting-dependent.

audit.verdict: CASTING-DEPENDENT (survives as a structural-requirement card on its FIRM leg; its DIVERGENCE leg must be downgraded, not sold). The card's firm core is defensible and well-evidenced: that a lawful layer is missing (E3 calibration-locked anti-control, must_not_seal_E1_or_E2, honest E.7 interlock booleans all FALSE so E0 is unreachable) and that the amplitude-over-geometry / state-of-the-metric object is non-descending from BOTH frozen Sigma_f -- this is read directly off the closure cards (GR self-certifies the exclusion as MISSING not hidden; QM has the amplitude but no metric argument). Content discipline is honored: no naming of the missing theory, explicit remains_unknown_content, no derive-across-layers, no up/down conflation, primer trap-1 refused. The OUT-OF-SAMPLE tests are genuine and falsifiable. HOWEVER the card's would-be field-redirecting move -- the asymmetric 'GR-geometry is a shadow of a deeper quantum-information substrate, so naive metric-quantization quantizes the wrong variable' divergence -- DOES NOT survive hard attack as a discovery: it rests on (i) an over-read of E023, a bidirectional duality-equivalence the digest itself defines as symmetric ('neither as source'), and (ii) a single E2-conditional currency edge (E024), atop (iii) GR's DELIBERATELY conservative classical casting which the GR card admits manufactures the 'geometry is a shadow' signal. The card is SAVED from an overreach verdict only because it is unusually honest about exactly this: it carries both readings, labels the tilt CONTESTED and casting-conditional, flags the E2-conditionality of every corroborating edge, and explicitly offers the casting-off reading per discipline rule 4. So the divergence holds but is a casting artifact that the card itself flags -- the required fix is to demote the asymmetric reading from the headline shape_verdict to a flagged secondary hypothesis and excise the E023 directional gloss, leaving the symmetric common-refinement / amplitude-over-geometry object as the firm, casting-robust shape.
